verification_steps.description: Send a query, wait 2 seconds, refresh page (F5). Verify prompt stays visible and thinking loader shows up.
Verify reactive polling updates both openedChatsHistory and currentChat until complete.
Verify thoughts preserve in_progress=true while active and map to aborted=true only when turn finishes.
Click 'Stop' button after page reload with no active AbortController; confirm polling stops, UI marks interrupted, and backend abort is called.
Verify polling ceiling at 150 attempts and timer cleanup on chat deletion.
